title: PINK MALL System Authority Contract
appliesTo: All PINK MALL / Pierciina systems, current and future, including campaign, story, social-intelligence, semantic-memory, execution and publication systems.
purpose: Define which system is authoritative for which domain of truth, how sources are classified, what happens when they disagree, and which data may exist in a public repository. This is the constitutional layer beneath every later domain contract.

canonicalityRule.statement: A contract is canonical only when all three conditions hold simultaneously.
conditions: It has passed owner or independent review.
It is committed to the canonical project branch claude/pink-mall-development.
Its machine-readable form passes its own validator.

statusFieldSemantics.CANDIDATE: Under review. MUST NOT be relied upon as project policy.
statusFieldSemantics.CANONICAL: All three conditions met. May be relied upon.
statusFieldSemantics.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a later version. Retained for history only.

canonicalityRule.promotionNote: The status field is evaluated against the branch the file is read from. A file marked CANDIDATE on the canonical branch after review is canonical by the three conditions; the flag records review lifecycle, not location, so the exact reviewed bytes can be promoted without rewriting them.

implementationStates.ACTIVE: Implemented, validated and in use on the canonical branch.
implementationStates.PARTIAL: Implemented in part, or implemented but not yet cleared for its full intended use.
implementationStates.PLANNED: Designed or reserved only. Does not exist. MUST NOT be described as capability.
implementationStates.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed until a named precondition is resolved.
implementationStates.HISTORICAL: Superseded. Preserved for provenance, not for use.

truthClasses.definition: Direct canonical or verified state, held by the authority for its domain.
truthClasses.example: PM-038 exists with price EUR 40 in PINK_MALL_PRODUCTS.

truthClasses.definition: Deterministic result computed from FACTs by a specified rule. Reproducible.
truthClasses.mutableBy: Only by changing an input FACT or the published derivation rule.
truthClasses.example: newIn membership computed from newUntil by the canonical freshness rule.

truthClasses.definition: Semantic conclusion, hypothesis or learning. Not verifiable by inspection of canonical state.
truthClasses.mutableBy: Semantic systems; never promotes itself to FACT.
truthClasses.example: This concept resonates with the audience.

truthClasses.definition: A suggested future action or creative direction. Carries no authority until approved.
truthClasses.example: Run a candle campaign in week 40.

truthClasses.definition: Model-created candidate asset or text. A candidate until it passes required QA and approval.
truthClasses.example: A generated campaign image of a product.

truthClasses.definition: Explicit authorized acceptance by the owner or a delegated authority, scoped and recorded.
truthClasses.mutableBy: Owner, or a delegate named by a canonical contract.

truthClassRules: These classes MUST NOT be collapsed into one another.
A GENERATED_OUTPUT MUST NOT be recorded as a FACT by virtue of having been produced.
An INTERPRETATION MUST NOT overwrite a FACT.
A PROPOSAL MUST NOT be executed as though it were an APPROVAL.

mediaClasses.definition: Exact approved product photography used for product and storefront truth.
mediaClasses.rule: MUST NOT be generatively altered. MUST NOT be replaced by campaign or derivative media.

mediaClasses.definition: Generated or campaign-directed creative media that may place real products and INA/SIS inside a campaign world.
mediaClasses.rule: MUST remain product-locked and identity-locked. MUST NOT enter the canonical commerce media path.

mediaClasses.definition: Crops, story adaptations, reels, overlays, captions and other derivative campaign formats.
mediaClasses.rule: Inherits the constraints of its source. MUST NOT silently replace canonical commerce media.

mediaClassRules: Campaign media and derivative media MUST NEVER silently replace canonical commerce media.
A media asset MUST carry its class. An asset of unknown class MUST be treated as GENERATED_OUTPUT and MUST NOT be published.

sourceTypes.note: Authorises policy and approvals. Does not replace domain authorities for derived or measured facts.

sourceTypes.role: Durable project state — the canonical branch of PIERCIINA-PROJECT.
sourceTypes.note: Persists policy and state. GitHub is the project state; model memory is not.

sourceTypes.role: Product publication workflow and product truth.
Human identity constraints and reference selection for INA/SIS/DUO.
Deterministic derivation of wardrobe authority from the canonical catalogue.
sourceTypes.note: Produces DERIVED_FACT only. Snapshots are never committed.

sourceTypes.role: Raw social metrics as measured by the platform.
sourceTypes.note: Evidence for metrics only; never for product or identity truth.

sourceTypes.role: Semantic and creative memory: interpretation, learning, campaign memory, preference drift.
sourceTypes.note: Explicitly non-authoritative for product, catalogue, approval and repository facts.
Connected and capable of generation. Produces GENERATED_OUTPUT only.

sourceTypes.role: Persistent visual workflow graph for campaign production.

sourceTypes.note: Executes, validates and reports. Does not become an authority by acting.
Never canonical. Uncommitted work is not project state.
Never sufficient evidence of durable policy on its own.

sourceTypes.role: Intended private operational store for material unsafe for a public repository.
sourceTypes.note: Intended name PINK-MALL-OPS. Does not exist. MUST NOT be described as existing.

authorityDomains.note: The owner authorises policy. The canonical repository persists it. A durable rule is not in force until it is committed to a canonical contract.
Branch, commit, hash and file state are read from the repository, never recalled. Verify by hash, not by filename.
Manufacturer identity, PM ID, taxonomy and approved factual enrichment. Product facts are never invented.
Owner-supplied PINK MALL price is the only price source of truth, persisted in the canonical catalogue.
Owner-supplied available sizes are the only availability source of truth.
Class CANONICAL_COMMERCE_MEDIA. Never generatively altered; generated campaign media never becomes canonical commerce media.
INA/SIS/DUO identity truth. Identity MUST NOT be inferred from generated output. One sister MUST NEVER be substituted for the other. Reference wardrobe is not identity truth.

CONSENT_AND_PROVENANCE.json records status OWNER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED for every subject and every allowed use. Commercial generated-likeness publication remains gated. This contract does not and must not assert that commercial consent has been completed.
Campaign status, execution plan and approval state. The registry does not exist; authority is reserved. Operational state MUST NOT be fabricated.
Narrative continuity. Where story memory and campaign operational fact disagree, the operational authority wins and semantic memory is corrected.
Measured platform metrics are evidence. They are not interpretation and carry no creative conclusion.
Conclusions such as resonance or fatigue are INTERPRETATION. Weighting and scoring belong to the future Social Intelligence contract.

Super Brain may govern interpretation. It is explicitly NON-AUTHORITATIVE for PM IDs, prices, sizes, availability, canonical product identity, approval state, branch or hash, campaign spend and publication state.
Class CAMPAIGN_MEDIA or DERIVATIVE_MEDIA. Output is a candidate until it passes QA and approval. It never redefines product truth or human identity.
Approval is an explicit recorded act. Silence is never approval.

Authority implication only: once the owner approves a campaign idea and selects a budget mode, planned paid generation may proceed within that approved ceiling; if the first batch fails QA, additional correction spend requires owner review. Budget modes, ceilings and credit limits are NOT defined here and belong to the future Campaign Execution contract.
Human approval is the current default for commercial publication. No system currently holds autonomous publishing authority.

Private strategy, private performance history and private likeness provenance. The private store does not exist; until it does, this material is held outside the repository and MUST NOT be committed to the public one.

ownerOverrideTypes.scope: A named product, campaign or action.
ownerOverrideTypes.rule: Affects only the named scope. MUST NOT silently mutate permanent policy. MUST be recorded with its scope.
ownerOverrideTypes.example: PM-041 was published with one image by owner-approved exception; the three-image media contract was unchanged for every other product.

ownerOverrideTypes.scope: How the system operates from now on.
ownerOverrideTypes.rule: MUST be reflected in the relevant canonical contract before any later system treats it as permanent policy. Until then it is a PROPOSED_DURABLE_CHANGE.

ownerAuthorityRules: The owner is the ultimate business-policy approver.
Chat history is never sufficient evidence of a durable rule when a canonical contract says otherwise.
A new owner instruction that conflicts with a durable contract MUST be classified as ONE_TIME_EXCEPTION or PROPOSED_DURABLE_CHANGE. It MUST NOT silently rewrite policy.

conflictRules.condition: Two canonical sources within the same authority domain disagree.
conflictRules.detail: Return a conflict requiring reconciliation. MUST NOT silently choose the more convenient source.

conflictRules.condition: Semantic, generated or interpreted state disagrees with canonical truth.
conflictRules.detail: Canonical truth wins. The stale semantic or generated state MUST be logged or flagged for correction.

conflictRules.condition: Generated output contradicts product truth or human identity.
conflictRules.detail: The output is rejected or sent to exception review. It never redefines the domain.

conflictRules.condition: A new owner instruction conflicts with a durable contract.
conflictRules.detail: Classify as ONE_TIME_EXCEPTION or PROPOSED_DURABLE_CHANGE before acting.

conflictRules.condition: Sources in different domains appear to disagree.
conflictRules.detail: There is no global ranking. Each question is answered by the authority for its own domain.

conflictRules.condition: A question does not map to any defined authority domain.
conflictRules.detail: An undefined domain is a gap in this contract, not a licence to improvise.

includes: storefront assets already approved for publication
private performance history not intentionally public
Super Brain exports containing private strategy or history

privacyRules: Material classified PRIVATE_OPS_REQUIRED MUST NOT be committed to the public repository.
Git LFS does not make public material private.
PINK-MALL-OPS is PLANNED. It MUST NOT be described as existing, and MUST NOT be created without an explicit separate authorisation.
Until the private store exists, PRIVATE_OPS_REQUIRED material is held outside version control.

writeAuthorities.precondition: Validated checkpoint or reviewed candidate promotion. Never a force push.
Approved exact product media only. Never generative.
Only under an explicit avatar-skill task. Never from generated output.
Change-control protocol, then review, then promotion.

changeControlProtocol.rule: Chat memory alone MUST NOT become permanent policy.
changeControlProtocol.appliesTo: Every durable change to this or any later system contract.

hardStops.statement: Two canonical sources in one domain disagree.
A question maps to no defined domain.
Commercial generated-likeness publication is attempted while AVATAR_CONSENT_STATUS is unresolved.
Material classified PRIVATE_OPS_REQUIRED or NEVER_PERSIST appears in a public-repository change.
Generated media or text is about to be written into a canonical factual path.
Commercial publication is attempted without an explicit recorded APPROVAL.
Work existing only in an ephemeral environment is about to be treated as project truth.
A durable rule is about to change without passing the change-control protocol.

creativeFreedomPrinciple.statement: World physics may break. Product truth may not. Human identity may not.

earnedAutonomy.principle: Autonomy is capability-specific, not a single global flag.
earnedAutonomy.rule: A system MAY earn autonomy in one domain while remaining manual in another. Any grant MUST be made explicitly by a later contract change based on proven history. No confidence thresholds are defined by this contract.
earnedAutonomy.currentPosture: No autonomous authority is granted by this contract.
